parentDecisionReviews.parentQuestion: Should historic candidate identity require authoritative identifiers or documented review rather than name-only matching?
parentDecisionReviews.parentRecommendedDecision: Require an exact or reviewed identity mapping to the current incumbent BioGuide.

parentDecisionReviews.parentQuestion: Should historic result geography require an exact key match or a separately reviewed crosswalk before scoring?
parentDecisionReviews.parentRecommendedDecision: Reject automatic current-boundary assumptions and require retained compatibility evidence.
